rfc8305_assessment.observable_behavior_summary: Out of scope: Unsupported check. The PS-028 dual-stack lab specifically instruments HTTP/1.1 over TCP. Alternative transport protocols (QUIC) are out of testbed scope and were not tested. SCTP is not specified in Happy Eyeballs v2 (RFC 8305) or Happy Eyeballs v3 (draft-ietf-happy-happyeyeballs-v3-04).
rfc8305_assessment.rfc_specification_requirement: Connection establishment determination for QUIC handshakes (draft-ietf-happy-happyeyeballs-v3-04 Section 6.1)
rfc8305_assessment.specification_context: draft-ietf-happy-happyeyeballs-v3-04 Section 6.1 specifies connection establishment determination for both TCP and QUIC handshakes. RFC 8305 Section 8 provides a Summary of Configurable Values and does not specify alternative transports. SCTP is not specified in either document. Untested protocols are out of testbed scope.

rfc8305_assessment.observable_behavior_summary: Observed alignment with RFC 8305 Section 3 recommendation: 40/40 (100.0%) valid live trials established primary connection over IPv6 on dual-stack baseline without fallback. Scoped to recorded trials under lab conditions; does not infer general client behavior.
rfc8305_assessment.rfc_specification_requirement: SHOULD prefer IPv6 for initial connection attempt (RFC 8305 Section 3 / v3 draft -04 Section 5.3)
rfc8305_assessment.specification_context: RFC 8305 Section 3 specifies that implementations SHOULD prefer IPv6 for the first connection attempt when both A and AAAA resource records are resolved. draft-ietf-happy-happyeyeballs-v3-04 Section 5.3 also prioritizes IPv6 destination endpoints.

rfc8305_assessment.observable_behavior_summary: Observed behavior when positive A response precedes positive AAAA response by ~500.000 ms: In 40/40 trials (20 Google Chrome, 20 Mozilla Firefox), both browsers waited for the late AAAA response (~500.000 ms; Google Chrome median 499.990 ms, Mozilla Firefox median 501.740 ms) and connected over IPv6 (0 IPv4 attempts), rather than initiating an IPv4 connection attempt after the 50.000 ms Resolution Delay recommended in RFC 8305 Section 3. Scoped to recorded trials under lab conditions; does not infer protocol violation or general browser non-conformance.
rfc8305_assessment.rfc_specification_requirement: RECOMMENDED 50 ms Resolution Delay before initiating IPv4 (RFC 8305 Section 3 / v3 draft -04 Section 7)
rfc8305_assessment.specification_context: RFC 8305 Section 3 recommends a 50 ms Resolution Delay when a positive A response arrives before a positive AAAA response. If positive AAAA arrives within 50 ms, an IPv4 attempt starting before AAAA arrival is an observed potential criterion mismatch. If positive AAAA arrives after 50 ms, an IPv4 attempt should be initiated within the 50 ms window. draft-ietf-happy-happyeyeballs-v3-04 Section 7 discusses DNS answer changes during connection setup.

rfc8305_assessment.observable_behavior_summary: Not assessed: Unsupported check. PS-028 testbed protocol unconditionally wipes browser user data directories (--user-data-dir) after each trial to guarantee cross-trial measurement independence. Cross-session persistence and adaptive failure caching cannot be evaluated.
rfc8305_assessment.rfc_specification_requirement: MAY remember historical RTT and previously used addresses for sorting (RFC 8305 Section 4 / v3 draft -04 Section 5.3)
rfc8305_assessment.specification_context: RFC 8305 Section 4 specifies sorting addresses, including historical RTT and previously used addresses. draft-ietf-happy-happyeyeballs-v3-04 Section 5.3 specifies sorting destination endpoints within groups using historical RTT and endpoint-use data. RFC 8305 Section 7 is dedicated to NAT64 and DNS64 support on IPv6-only networks. Clean profile isolation per trial prevents cross-trial state evaluation.
rfc8305_assessment.target_parameter: Historical Address Selection and Past State Caching

rfc8305_assessment.observable_behavior_summary: Observed inter-attempt spacing on TCP RST active failure: 20/40 trials (Mozilla Firefox, median CAD 160.425 ms [130.780 - 336.230 ms]) recorded first-IPv4-SYN after >= 10.000 ms (falling within the 100.000–2000.000 ms CAD range); 20/40 trials (Google Chrome, median CAD 0.710 ms [0.350 - 6.820 ms]) recorded first-IPv4-SYN within < 10.000 ms of first-IPv6-SYN. Pooled median delay across all 40 trials is 68.800 ms. However, because connection attempt delay measurements are derived from family-wide first-SYN timestamps without establishing verified attempt pairing, socket transaction causality, or chronological attempt correlation, these observed intervals cannot be validly assessed against the 10 ms mandatory floor criterion. Scoped to recorded trials under lab conditions; does not claim browser non-conformance.
rfc8305_assessment.rfc_specification_requirement: Subsequent connection MUST NOT be started within 10 milliseconds of the previous attempt (RFC 8305 Section 5 / v3 draft -04 Section 6)
rfc8305_assessment.specification_context: RFC 8305 Section 5 and draft-ietf-happy-happyeyeballs-v3-04 Section 6 distinguish mandatory inter-attempt spacing (subsequent connection attempts MUST NOT start within 10 milliseconds of the previous attempt) from recommended CAD parameters (100 ms to 2000 ms, default 250 ms). Neither specification contains an immediate-retry requirement upon TCP RST. Evaluation of attempt spacing requires verified sequential pairing within the same logical setup; unestablished attempt pairing cannot be evaluated as a criterion mismatch.

rfc8305_assessment.observable_behavior_summary: Observed behavior under 600.000 ms IPv6 path delay: IPv4 connection established first in 39/40 trials (pooled median CAD 305.100 ms; Google Chrome: 20/20 IPv4 wins [median 300.810 ms]; Firefox: 19/20 IPv4 wins [median 397.940 ms]). All 39 measured CAD values satisfy the 10.000 ms mandatory floor and fall within the recommended [100.000, 2000.000] ms range. In 1/40 trials (Firefox trial trial-20261029222109-5c74c26a), IPv6 completed without an IPv4 attempt being initiated. Scoped to recorded trials under lab conditions; does not infer general client non-conformance.
rfc8305_assessment.rfc_specification_requirement: CAD timer SHOULD NOT < 100 ms and MAX 2000 ms; IPv4 path expected to complete first (RFC 8305 Section 5 / v3 draft -04 Section 6)
rfc8305_assessment.specification_context: RFC 8305 Section 5 and draft-ietf-happy-happyeyeballs-v3-04 Section 6 distinguish mandatory inter-attempt spacing (MUST NOT start within 10 ms) from recommended CAD parameters (100 ms to 2000 ms). Under high primary-path latency (600 ms RTT), the client is expected to initiate an IPv4 attempt after the CAD timer, which finishes setup first over the low-latency path.

rfc8305_assessment.observable_behavior_summary: Observed alignment with RFC 8305 Section 5 recommended parameters: 40/40 trials initiated IPv4 fallback attempt within the recommended [100.000, 2000.000] ms window (pooled median CAD 342.155 ms; Google Chrome median 301.190 ms, Mozilla Firefox median 396.960 ms), satisfying the 10.000 ms mandatory inter-attempt floor. Scoped to recorded trials under lab conditions.
rfc8305_assessment.rfc_specification_requirement: Subsequent connection MUST NOT be started within 10 milliseconds of previous attempt; CAD timer SHOULD NOT < 100 ms; RECOMMENDED default 250 ms; MAX 2000 ms (RFC 8305 Section 5 / v3 draft -04 Section 6)
rfc8305_assessment.specification_context: RFC 8305 Section 5 and draft-ietf-happy-happyeyeballs-v3-04 Section 6 distinguish mandatory inter-attempt spacing (MUST NOT be smaller than 10 ms) from recommended CAD timer parameters (SHOULD NOT be smaller than 100 ms, recommended default 250 ms, maximum 2000 ms) on unresponsive paths.
